ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL( Private_Terminal_Type__c , "HYLG"), OR( ISBLANK(Nationality_Region__c), ISBLANK(Passport_No__c), ISBLANK(Passport_Expiry_Date__c), ISBLANK(Birthday__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Private Terminal Type = HYLG, the following fields can't be empty: "Nationality/Region", "Passport No.", "Passport Expiry Date", "Birthday".
